title: @idem/ndn against a real NFD
description: The native binding (@idem/ndn) talking to NFD 24.07 in Docker (experiments/ndn/nfd): round trip, PIT aggregation, Content Store and freshness, equivalent spellings, private scope, tampering, the packet size limit, a two-forwarder chain and a WebSocket face. Wall-clock: NFD runs in real time.
